blocks.text: If you have multiple apps to manually add to the App Inventory, you can save time by uploading them in bulk using their client IDs.

blocks.item: In the left-side navigation, go to Inventory.
Click the Upload Apps icon in the upper-right corner.
In the Upload Applications window, enter the client IDs you want to add, separated by commas.

blocks.text: You can use any delimiter, not just a comma (,).
A summary appears. Apps in Pending mode are submitted for sandboxing. After some time, you receive an email when they are uploaded.
You can also manually upload apps from 3rd-Party App Governance's App Catalog to your inventory. To learn more, see Searching for Apps.
